candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/14 is an access port in VLAN 30 (the CORP zone VLAN) without a shutdown, instead of VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Set switchport access vlan 10 on GigabitEthernet1/0/14 (or shut the port if it is unused), as in the approved baseline.

candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/14 on sw-ot-01 deviates from the approved baseline: switchport access vlan changed from 10 to 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the deviation by reverting the access VLAN to 10 or by documenting the change as approved.
